m: व्य्-√ उ P. -उनोति, to urge on, incite, animate, RV. v, 31, 1.
व्य्-√ उब्ज् P. -उब्जति, to uncover open, display, AV.
व्य्-उच्छत् &c. See वि-√ वस्.
व्य्-˚उच्छेद m. = ˚उच्छित्ति, HPariś.
व्य्-˚उच्छेत्तृ mfn. who or what cuts off or destroys (see अ-व्युच्छेत्तृ).
व्य्-उच्-छिद् (-उद्-√ छिद्) only Pass. (with act. terminations) -छिद्यति, to be cut off or interrupted or extirpated, become extinct, come to an end, cease, fail, MBh.
व्य्-˚उच्छिन्न mfn. cut off, extirpated, destroyed, interrupted, ceased, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
व्य्-उच्छित्ति f. cutting off or short, interruption, disturbance, MBh.; MārkP.
a: व्युच्छित्तिः — f., व्युच्छेदः Cutting off, extermination, complete destruction.

m: व्य्-उच्-√ चर् (-उद्-√ चर्) P. Ā. -चरति, ˚ते, to go forth in different directions, ŚBr.; to go out of the right path, transgress or offend against, be faithless or disloyal towards (acc.), MBh.; to commit adultery with (instr.), ib.
a: व्युच्चर् — {c1c} P. 1 To transgress, offend against, violate. --2 To be faithless to. --3 To commit adultery with. --4 To deviate from the right path.
व्युच्चरणं — Transgression; deviation.

m: व्य्-उच्य mfn. (√ vac) to be contradicted or contested (n. impers.), TāṇḍBr.
व्य्-√ उद् (or उन्द्), P. -उनत्ति, to spring or gush forth, RV.; to sprinkle thoroughly, wet, drench, ib.; AV.

s: vyudAsaH

puM, (vi + ut + asa + GaY .) nirAsaH । parityAgaH । yaTA । tadEvetyevakAraSravaRAttiTidvEDe KaRqaviSezo niyamyate karmmaRi KaRqAntaravyudAsAya । ityamAvAsyASrAdDakAlanirUpaRe tiTyAditattvam ॥ (yaTA ca mahABArate । 12 । 19 । 18 । “aTEkAntavyudAsena SarIre pAYcaBOtike ॥”)
v: pu॰ vi + ud + asa + GaY । nirAkaraRe ।
m: व्य्-उदास m. throwing away, giving up, abandonment, MBh.
rejection, exclusion, Sāh.; Kull.
disregard for, indifference to, W.
destruction (of an enemy), Śiś. xv, 37
cessation, end, Nalod.
a: व्युदासः — 1 Throwing aside, rejection. --2 Exclusion (in gram.). --3 Prohibition. --4 Disregard, indifference. --5 Killing, destruction; Śi. 15. 37.

m: व्य्-उद्-√ धाव् Caus. -धावयति, to cause to be rubbed off or polished or cleansed, Lāṭy.
व्य्-उद्-धृ (-उद्-√ हृ) P. -हरति (ind.p. उद्धारम्), to distribute in drawing up or taking out, TS.; ŚrS.; Nyāyam.; to extract, draw out of (abl.), BhP.
व्य्-उद्-√ ऊह् P. -ऊहति (Pot. -उह्यात्), to push apart or asunder, move away or out, TS.; to sweep out or away, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
व्य्—उद mfn. waterless, dry, BhP.
व्य्—उदक mf(आ)n. id., ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Āpast.; BhP.
व्य्-उद्-√ अस् P. -अस्यति, to throw about, scatter, Kauś.; MBh.; to discharge, emit, Gaut.; to cast off, reject, give up, abandon, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: व्युदस् — {c4c} P. 1 To throw or scatter about. --2 To throw off, cast away. --3 To set or lay aside. --4 To give up, abandon.

m: व्य्-उदस्त mfn. thrown or scattered about, cast off, thrown aside, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: व्युदस्त — p. p. Thrown aside, rejected, cast off.

m: व्य्-उद्-ग्रन्थन n. (√ ग्रथ्) binding up with several strings, KātyŚr.
व्य्-उदित mfn. (√ वद्) disputed, debated, discussed, contested, ŚāṅkhBr.
a: व्युदित — a. Disputed, discussed, debated.

m: व्य्-√ उक्ष् P. Ā. -उक्षति, ˚ते, (P.) to sprinkle, pour out, ŚBr.; (Ā.) to besprinkle, wet, RV. x, 90, 3.
व्य्-उन्दन n. the act of well moistening or wetting, VS.
व्य्-उन्-मिश्र mfn. intermingled or mixed with, soiled or adulterated with (instr.), MBh. (v.l. वि-मिश्र).
व्य्-उपा-√ रम् P. -रमति, to desist from, leave off, cease, Hariv. (cf. व्य्-उप-√ रम् above).
व्य्-उपास् (-उप- √ 2. अस्) P. -उपास्यति, to throw about, distribute, ŚBr.
व्युप (?) m. one who eats out of his own hands, L.
व्य्-उपशान्त mfn. calmed, allayed, ceased (as pain), Kāraṇḍ.
desisting, Divyāv.
व्य्-उप-√ शम् P. -शाम्यति (ep. also ˚ते), to become quiet, be allayed, cease, MBh.
1. व्य्—उपशम m. (for 2. See व्युप-√ शम्) non-cessation, not ceasing or desisting, Mālatīm.; Sāh.
inquietude, MW.
2. व्य्-उपशम m. (for 1. See p. 1029, col. 1) cessation, end, Mālatīm. (v.l. for व्य्-उपरम), Sāh.
relief, Divyāv.
a: व्युपशमः — 1 Non-cessation. --2 Inquietude. --3 Complete cessation (where वि shows intensity).

m: व्य्-उप-देश m. (√ दिस्) pretext, pretence, W. (prob. w.r. for व्य्-अप-देश).
a: व्युपदेशः — Pretext, pretence.

m: व्य्—उपद्रव mfn. undisturbed by any misfortune, not liable to unlucky accidents, Suśr.
व्य्-उप-जाप m. (√ जप्; less correct व्य्-उप-जाव) whispering aside or apart, telling in a whisper, Āpast.
व्य्-उप-कार m. (√ 1. कृ) completely observing or accomplishing or satisfying (duty &c.), R.
व्य्-उप-√ नी P. -नयति, to lead or bring (sacrificial victims) separately or one by one, ŚBr.
व्य्-उप-पत्ति f. (√ पद्) re-birth, Divyāv.

व्य्-उप-√ रम् Ā. -रमते (ep. also ˚ति; ind.p. -रमम्; in augmented forms not separable from व्य्-उपा-√ रम् below), to leave off or pause variously, ĀśvŚr.; to come to an end, cease, MBh.; Hariv.; to desist from (abl.), MBh.
व्य्-उपरम m. pause, cessation, interruption, MBh.; Hariv.; Kāv.
end, close (of day), Hariv.
a: व्युपरमः — Cessation, stop, close.

m: व्य्-उपरमम् ind. See व्य्-उप-√ रम् above.
व्य्-उपरत mfn. rested, stopped, ceased, desisted, MBh.; Mṛcch.
व्य्—उपस्कर mfn. without appurtenance, MBh.
व्य्-उप-तोद m. (√ tud) striking against, ib.
व्य्—उपवीत mfn. devoid of the sacred thread, Prāyaśc.
व्य्-उपवीत See p. 1029, col. 1.
व्य्-उप-√ विश् P. -विशति, to sit down at different places, ŚBr.
व्य्-उप-√ युज् Ā. -युङ्क्ते, to be concerned about or intent upon (acc.), MBh. v, 992 (v.l.)
व्य्-उपे (-उप- √ 3. इ) P. -उपैति, to extend or be distributed (intr.) in or over, Kath.
1. व्य्-उप्त mfn. (p.p. of वि-√ वप्) shaved, shorn
2. व्य्-उप्त mfn. (p.p. of वि-√ वप्) scattered about, disordered, dishevelled
2. व्य्-उप्त—जटा-कलाप mfn. having a dishevelled mass of hair, BhP.
1. व्य्-उप्त—केश mfn. one whose hair is shorn, MaitrS.
2. व्य्-उप्त—केश mfn. having dishevelled hair, BhP.
व्य्-उप्त—केश m. N. of Rudra and of Fire (as identified with R˚), MW.

व्य्-उत्-था (-उद्-√ स्था) P. Ā. -तिष्ठति, ˚ते, to rise in different directions (as light), RV.; to turn away from (abl.), give up, abandon, ŚBr.; to swerve from duty, forget one's self, MBh.; R.; to come back (from sea, cf. व्य्-उत्-√ पद्), Divyāv. : Caus. -थापयति, to cause to rise up &c.; to call in question, disagree about (acc.), MBh.; to seduce, win over, ib.; to set aside, remove, depose (from a place), Kathās.; to abandon treacherously, ib.
a: व्युत्था — {c1c} A. 1 To get up, rise. --2 To increase in strength or power, grow strong. --Caus. To excite, instigate, rouse.

s: vyutTAnaM

klI, (vi + ut + sTA + lyuw .) svAtantryakftyam । viroDAcaraRam । iti medinI ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 14 । 29 । 16 । “evaM te draviqABIrA puRqrASca SavarEH saha । vfzalatvaM parigatA vyutTAnAt kzattraDarmmiRaH ॥”) pratiroDanam । samADipAraRam । iti hemacandraH ॥ nftyaBedaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ viSezeRotTAnaYca ॥ (cittasyAvasTAviSazaH । iti pAtaYjaladarSanam ॥)
v: na॰ vi + ud + sTA--lyuw । 1 virADakaraRe 2 svAtintryakaraRe medi॰ 3 pratiroDane 4 yogaSAstvAkte samADyavasTApracyave hemaca॰ 5 nftyaBede Sabdaca॰ । 6 viSezeRa utTAne ca । vi + ud + sTA--ktin । vyutTitirapyatra strI ।
m: व्य्-उत्थान n. rising up, awakening (a partic. stage in Yoga), Vedāntas.
yielding, giving way (in अ-व्य्˚), MBh.
swerving from the right course, neglect of duties, ib.
opposition, L.
independent action, L.
a kind of dancing or gesticulation, MW.
a: व्युत्थानं, व्युत्थितिः — f. 1 Great activity. --2 Rising up against, opposition, obstruction. --3 Independent action, following one's own bent of mind. --4 The completion of religious abstraction or abstract meditation (in Yoga phil.). --5 A kind of dance. --6 Causing (an elephant) to rise; Śi. 18. 26. --7 Contradicting.

k.v: उत्थानं पौरुषे तन्त्रे सन्निविष्टोद्गमेऽपि च। व्युत्थानं प्रतिरोधे च विरोधाचरणेऽपि च॥
उत्थानं पौरुषे तन्त्रे सन्निविष्टोद्गमेऽपि च। व्युत्थानं प्रतिरोधे च विरोधाचरणेऽपि च॥

m: व्य्-˚उत्थापित mfn. (fr. Caus.) made to rise up, roused, brought up, ib.
व्य्-उत्थातव्य n. (impers.) it is to be desisted from (abl.), Śaṃk.
व्य्-उत्थित mfn. greatly divergent in opinion, MBh.
strongly excited or agitated (see comp.)
swerving from duty (with or scil. धर्मात्), Hariv.; Sarvad.
व्य्-उत्थित˚चित्ताश्व m. N. of a prince, VP.
व्य्-उत्थित—चित्त mfn. strongly excited in mind, Sarvad.
व्य्-उत्थित-चि˚त्तेन्द्रिय mfn. greatly agitated in the senses or feelings, Hariv.

s: vyutaH
tri, (vi + ve + ktaH .) syUtam । iti BaratadvirUpakozaH ॥
m: व्य्-उत See s.v.
व्य्-उत mfn. (√ वे) interwoven, woven, variegated (as a garment), RV.; ŚBr.
levelled (as a road), RV. iii, 54, 9.

s: vyutiH
strI, (vi + ve + ktin .) UtiH । tantusantatiH । iti BaratadvirUpakozaH ॥
m: व्य्-˚उति f. weaving, sewing, L.

a: व्युत्क्रांत — p. p. 1 Transgressed, overstepped. --2 Departed, left, gone forth. --3 Neglected. --ता A kind of riddle.

m: व्य्-उत्क्रान्ता f. (scil. प्रहेलिका) a kind of riddle, Kāvyād.
व्य्-उत्क्रान्त mfn. gone apart or in different directions &c. (pl. with द्वंद्वम् = ‘paired off’), Pāṇ.; ib., Sch.
gone away, departed, removed, ceased (see comp.)
transgressed, disregarded, ib.
व्य्-उत्क्रान्त—धर्म mfn. neglectful of duty, MBh.
व्य्-उत्क्रान्त—जीवित mfn. one whose life has departed, lifeless, dead, Daś.
व्य्-उत्क्रान्˚तक-समापत्ति f. a partic. stage of concentration, Buddh.
व्य्-उत्क्रान्त—रजस् mfn. one whose impurity is removed, free from passion, ib.
व्य्-उत्क्रान्त—वर्त्मन् mfn. one who has gone beyond the right path, Bhaṭṭ.
व्य्-उत्-√ क्रम् P. -क्रामति, to go apart or in different directions, AitBr.; ŚBr.; to overstep, transgress, neglect, Ragh.; to go astray, MW.
a: व्युत्क्रम् — See उत्क्रम्.

s: vyutkramaH

puM, (vi + ut + krama + GaY .) kramaviparyyayaH । vyatikramaH । tatparyyAyaH । utkramaH 2 akramaH 3 । iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, sAhityadarpaRe । 10 । “paSyet kaSciccala capala re kA tvarAhaM kumArI hastagrAhaM vitara hahahA vyutkramaH kvAsi yAsi ॥”)
v: pu॰ vi + ud + krama--GaY । 1 kramavEparItye 2 atikrame ca hemaca॰ ।
m: व्य्-उत्क्रम m. going astray or out of the right course, inverted order, Śāṇḍ.; Vedāntas.
transgression, offence, VarBṛS.; BhP.
dying, death, L.
a: व्युत्क्रमः — 1 Transgression, going astray. --2 Inverted order, contrariety. --3 Confusion, disorder.

m: व्य्-˚उत्क्रमण n. going apart, separation, Pāṇ. viii, 1, 15.

s: vyutpAdakaH
tri, (viSezeRotpAdayati jYAnam । vi + ut + pada + Ric + Rvul .) vyutpattijanakaH । yaTA । SabdavyutpAdakaSAstrAramBe SabdEreva maNgalaM karttavyam । iti mugDaboDawIkAyAM durgAdAsaH ॥
m: व्य्-उत्पादक mfn. (fr. Caus.) giving rise to, producing, productive, MW.
tracing back (a word to its root &c.), explaining etymologically, L.
व्य्-˚उत्पादन n. etymological explanation, derivation from (abl.), Madhus.
teaching, instruction, VarBṛS., Sch.
व्य्-˚उत्पाद्य mfn. capable of being traced back to its root, derivable, Sāṃkhyak.
to be explained or discussed, Nyāyam.

व्य्-उत्-√ पद् Ā. -पद्यते (aor. व्युद्-अपादि), to proceed from, arise, originate, have origin or derivation (esp. in gram.), be derived (from a root &c.), Śiś. x, 23; (P.) to come back (from sea, cf. व्य्-उत्था), Divyāv.; to resist (?), ib. : Caus. -पादयति, to cause to arise or come forth, produce, cause, BhP.; (in gram.) to derive, trace back to a root &c., Śaṃk.; to discuss in detail, Hcar. : Desid. See व्य्-उत्पित्सु, col. 2.
a: व्युत्पद् — {c4c} A. 1 To be produced from, originate in. --2 To be derived from (a root &c.). --3 To become proficient in or {{conversaut->conversant||20210104|Dr. Sampada Savardekar and Jim Funderburk|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/20|}} with. --Caus. 1 To produce, cause. --2 To derive, trace to a root (as a word); ब्रह्मशब्दस्य व्युत्पाद्यमानस्य Ś. B.

s: vyutpannaH

tri, (vi + ut + pada + ktaH .) saMskftaH । iti hemacandraSabdaratnAvalyO ॥ vyutpattiyuktaH । yaTA । vyAkaraRavyutpannaSabdajYAnADInaM SAstrAntarajYAnaM tadaDInA ca vEdikakriyA tatPalaM svargAdi । iti mugDaboDawIkAyAM durgAdAsaH ॥
v: tri॰ vi + ud + pada--kta । 1 vyutpattiyukte Sabde tatasaMskArayukte 2 puruze ca । 3 viSezeRotpanne ca ।
m: व्य्-उत्पन्न mfn. arisen, originated, derived (esp. in gram.), to be explained etymologically (see अ-व्य्-˚)
learned, accomplished, experienced, versed in (instr.), Bhartṛ.; BhP.; Nyāyam., Sch.
a: व्युत्पन्न — p. p. 1 Produced, begotten. --2 Formed by derivation. --3 Derived, traced to its etymology, as a word (opp. अव्युत्पन्न or ‘primitive’). --4 Completed, perfected; Mv. 4. 57. --5 Thoroughly proficient in, learned, erudite.

s: vyutpattiH

strI, (vi + ut + pad + ktin .) viSezeRotpattiH । saMskAraH । iti vyutpannaSabdArTadarSanAt । yaTA । SaratkAlaboDanIyatvena SAradApadavyutpattestat padaM tAlavyAdi sAraM datAtIti vyutpattistu kAlpanikI । iti tiTyAditattvam ॥ SaktijYAnam । yaTA । vyavahArAdivADakaM vinA vivaraRAdapi vyutpatteH । vADakaM vinA svasADyasya vADakaM yadviSezaRaM tadaBAvavattvaviSezaRasahakAreRa vyutpatteH vyutpattisamBavAt SaktigrahasamBavAditi yAvat । iti AKyAtavAdasya mATurI wIkA ॥
v: strI vi + ud + pada--ktin । 1 viSezeRa utpattO SAstrajanyeSabdArTajYAnAdisampAdye saMskAraBede 3 SabdA॰ nAmarTAvaboDakaSaktO ca ।
m: व्य्-उत्पत्ति f. production, origin, derivation (esp. in gram.), etymology, Nyāyam.; Sāh.; Vop.
development, perfection, growth (esp. in knowledge), proficiency (esp. in literature or science), comprehensive learning or scholarship, Nyāyam.; Kap.; Bālar. &c.
difference of tone or sound (fr. 3. वि denoting variation), VarBṛS.
a: व्युत्पत्तिः — f. 1 Origin, production. --2 Derivation, etymology. --3 Perfect proficiency, conversancy. --4 Scholarship, learning; व्युत्पत्तिरावर्जितकोविदापि न रंजनाय क्रमते जडानां Vikr. 1. 16, 18. 108.

m: व्य्-उत्पत्ति—दीपिका f. N. of wk. (also called प्राकृत-प्रक्रिया-वृत्ति)
व्य्-उत्पत्ति—मत् mfn. learned, cultured, Śaṃk.
व्य्-उत्पत्ति—पक्षे ind. on the side of derivation or etymology (an expression used by Vedic commentators when the accentuation is settled by the affixes and not accord. to the meanings of the words)
व्य्-उत्पत्ति—रहस्य n. N. of wk.
व्य्-उत्पत्ति—रहित mfn. destitute of (clear) derivation, not to be explained etymologically, Kusum.
व्य्-उत्पत्ति—रत्नाकर m. N. of wk.
व्य्-उत्पत्ति—वादार्थ m. N. of wk.
व्य्-उत्पत्ति—वाद m. N. of wk.
व्य्-उत्पत्ति—वाद-क्रोड-पत्त्र n. N. of wk.
व्य्-उत्पत्ति—वाद-पर्याय-पत्त्र n. N. of wk.
व्य्-उत्पत्ति—वाद-पत्त्र n. N. of wk.
व्य्-उत्पत्ति—वाद-रहस्य n. N. of wk.
व्य्-उत्पत्ति—वाद-टीका f. N. of wk.
व्य्-उत्पित्सु mfn. (fr. Desid.) desirous of making proficiency (in any science), MW.
व्य्-उत्-√ सद् P. -सीदति, to go out or away, AitBr.; to be unsettled, MW.; to be upset or overthrown, ib.
व्य्-उत्सर्ग m. renunciation, resignation, HYog.
व्य्-उत्सेक m. pouring out in different directions, ĀpŚr., Sch.
व्य्-उत्-√ सृज् P. -सृजति, to give away, give up, leave, abandon, ĀpŚr.; BhP.
व्य्-उत्-√ सृप् P. -सर्पति, to go out (of a place), AitBr.
व्य्-उत्-√ सिच् P. -सिञ्चति, to pour out or sprinkle in different directions, ĀpŚr.
व्य्-उत्-√ तॄ Caus. -तारयति, to pour cut in different directions, MānŚr.
व्य्-उत्त mfn. well sprinkled or wetted, drenched, TS.
a: व्युत्त — p. p. Wetted, drenched.

m: व्य्-उत्-√ त्रस् Caus. -त्रासयति, to scare or frighten away, disperse, ĀpŚr.

1. व्युष् (also read प्युष्) cl. 4. P. व्युषति, to burn (in this sense perhaps = व्य्-उष्), Dhātup. xxvi, 7; to divide, distribute (in this sense also written प्युस्, पुष्, ब्युस्, बुस्), ib. 108; cl. 10. P. व्योषयति, to reject, discharge, emit (in this sense also written पुस्), ib. xxxii, 92.
